rows.label: tlk70000014_05_msg0001
rows.name:
Laura-san, Hikari-san! I'm so glad we
can talk like this again.

rows.label: tlk70000014_05_msg0002
rows.name:
I can't do anything, but I believe
we'll be able to talk like this again.

rows.label: tlk70000014_05_msg0003
rows.name:
I have so much I want you to hear
about Leon and Azzaro too.

rows.label: tlk70000014_05_msg0004
rows.name:
I also want to ask how Laura-san and
Hikari-san usually spend time with
people close to them...

rows.label: tlk70000014_05_msg0005
rows.name:
I-I want to try doing things friends
do together. So...

rows.label: tlk70000014_05_msg0006
rows.name:
Please come back and show me your
healthy faces again. Definitely.

rows.label: tlk70000014_05_msg0007
rows.name:
This is just a small token. I don't
know if it'll be useful.

rows.label: tlk70000014_05_msg0008
rows.name:
But, well, I'd be really happy
if you got some use out of it.
